english: Minding the shop on a weekday afternoon is boring, nyo~♪
...Dejiko.
Hm? Nine coming here is rare, nyo.
I'm here too~.\nI brought a guest.
A guest, nyo?
Good day.
Nyo!?
I won't eat you or anything.\nI've come to talk.
Talk about what, nyo?
About Koto, of course.
Yase-douji has no hostile intent either,\nso I brought her along thinking\nwe should negotiate properly.
...Talking matters.
//fade to black\n//inside Gamers
Huh, so Tesla-san and Nine-san\nknow Yase?
Sort of.
Still, why did you\nattack us?\nYou could've just negotiated from the start.
About one person - an idiot who charged in\nall fired up for nothing, nyu.
Who's that, nyo?
You, nyu!!
Yase's a really important person in Kagami.\nOf all people, meeting Dejiko first -\nno wonder it got messy.
I didn't understand the situation then.\nForgive my rudeness, nyo.
I was a bit too misanthropic myself.\nI still don't like humans, but\nI don't dislike a child who can apologize properly.
So, Yase, what did you come to talk about?
About taking you back to Kagami, of course.
I'm not going back.\nWe're fighting some pretty bad guys right now.\nEveryone's still fighting - I don't want to go home alone.
You're precious to Kagami.\nIf anything happened to you, it'd be a disaster.
That's not just me.\nEveryone's precious.
Koto...!
Yes. From what I've seen, Koto-san\ndoesn't seem to be just playing around.
I'm worried about Koto.
Then I just have to prove\nthere's nothing to worry about, right?
Prove it how?
Match me!\nIf Yase wins, I'll go back.
If I lose, you won't go back?
Right. Win or lose, no hard feelings!
Fine. Simple is good.
Should've done that\nfrom the start, nyo...
The one who made a mess of things, be quiet, nyu.
Eh, whatever!\nComplicated stuff is best solved simply!
//Battle map: forest (night)\n//Initially deployed: Yase and Koto only.
How about it? One-on-one?
That's no fun.\nCan we do teams?
Anything's fine. I'll just win.
Me too! Okay, everyone come out!
//Player deployment.
Do your best, desu~!
You got it! I'm totally gonna win!
Koto-chan!\nA victory feast with extra rice awaits!
Hehe, tell Siesta-san\nto make it two extra-large servings!
(That lady Yase is lovely.\nA different elegance from Cecilia-san.)
(She's scary though...)
(A woman is best\nwith a claw or two hidden.\nNo spice at all is troubling too.)
(Is that how it is...)
I won't hold back either!
//Yase sends out her youkai army too.
All right, let's go!
I can't lose to a child!
//Battle start.\n//Talk event when Koto and Yase engage.
Yase! This hurts when it hits!
You haven't forgotten who I am, have you?\nWorrying about me is ten years too early!
//Conversation after Koto and Yase engage.
Hehe, this is fun too!
Honestly, you're such a tomboy!
Those two look like they're having fun, nyo?
Ufufu, they're really good friends, I'm sure.
High-level\nskinship, you could say.
A-awawa... th-that's so intense,\nI'm a little worried...!
A match is more fun the more even it is.\nThat's how it goes.
Go Koto-chan!!
//Event when Yase's HP drops below a set amount or after several turns: Black Koto and Black Yase appear.
You're quite persistent.
You too, Yase!
Come on!
Teeryaaah!!
//Black Koto and Black Yase appear.
Uooooooh!!\nSmaaash!!
...Die.
Ah!
Wh-what are those?
//Black Koto attacks Yase; Black Yase attacks Koto.
Whoa!
Hey! We were in the middle of something!
I'll break you too, you too!
Every last one of you, die!
//Event CG: Yase uses sorcery.
How annoying!!\nAre you trying to anger me!?
Scary!!
Scary, nyo...
Smash? "Die"? Are you stupid!\nI'll show you\nsomething far worse!
I'll torment you in a prison of never-ending suffering\nwith a daily-changing menu!
//Event CG off.
Hmph!
Hey, Yase...
Hah, trying to compete with me and Koto -\nwhat fools.
Match paused. Decided. Ready...!
Don't get in our way!
//Victory condition changes from defeating Yase to defeating Black Koto and Black Yase.
Smash!
Smash what!?
//Talk event when Koto and Black Yase engage.
Die!
Did I do something to earn your grudge?\nSorry, don't remember!
//Talk event when Yase and Black Koto engage.
You'll be the first to break!
I don't know what you're angry about, but\nfighting you wouldn't be fun.
//Talk event when Yase and Black Yase engage.
I'll kill you while I can.
First, stop talking down to me.\nIt'll be embarrassing if you lose.
//Clear upon defeating both Black Koto and Black Yase.
All cleaned up.
What now? Continue?
I'm not in the mood anymore.
Yeah!
//Battle end.\n//Background: forest (night)
Huh? I win?
You weren't beaten by me, so Koto wins.\nI acknowledge you have that much strength.
Really!?
But don't forget this.\nYou're absolutely needed to celebrate Koto-sama's birthday\nand revive Mama.
Yeah, once I finish what I'm doing now,\nI promise I'll come back to Kagami.\nSo wait just a little!
Fine, do as you wish, Koto.
Thank you! I love you, Yase!
Fufu, going at it flashily isn't bad, but\nthis is better.
//If Yase joins:
Since I'm here, maybe I'll help\nso Koto can return to Kagami sooner.
Really! That makes me happy, Yase!
That being the case,\nyou - arrange my food, clothing, and shelter.
Nyo!? Dejiko has to do it, nyo!?
You're wearing a maid outfit, so obviously.
Siesta does better work\nthan Dejiko, nyo!
I'll put up with you.\nDo it properly.
(I preferred her as an enemy, nyo...)
I can hear you, you know?
Damn, nyo! She's got demon ears, nyo!!
Wahahaha!
//If Yase doesn't join:
Well, I'll be waiting, Koto.\nDo your best.
Okay!
What a good answer!\nEveryone else, take care of Koto.
Okay! Leave it to us!
Leave it to me too!
I'll take good care of her too!
Kagami took care of me too.\nLet me repay that debt.
Good friends, Koto.
Yeah!
//Chris quietly steps away from the group.\n//fade to black\n//Event CG: Chris looking up at the night sky
Papa... Mama...
You know, understanding each other is a good thing.
I'm clumsy, so\nI might not do it well, but\nI want a peaceful world where everyone understands each other.
I'll make it happen\nwith the power of this song Papa and Mama gave me...!
Dammit! Let me smash more!
More death! Death to fools!
//Black Rem walks in.
Welcome. Glad you came.
You're the one who called us?
First, let's hear your proposal.
We must unite.\nOr we'll lose.
Blunt, aren't you.
Yes, it's clear.\nThat uniting means victory.
Is that true?
The plan is already in motion.\nHey, come here.
//Black Rika and Black Louise walk in.
Hey.
I'll kill Louise\nand meet Gandalfr...
These two and I will lead.
Counter numbers with numbers.
This world exists for us.
Come to me.\nAnd fulfill your desires to your heart's content.
What's your desire?
The destruction... of this twisted world!
//END
